jetpack-related-posts.title: Endowed fellowship looks to the future
jetpack-related-posts.author: Colleen Sullivan
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Baila Janock embodies generosity in its many forms. For over 30 years, she has combined her gifts of time, treasure, and talent to make a long-lasting impact on Dana-Farber Cancer Institute and its patients.

img.alt_text: Robert Mayer, MD, Baila Janock, and Janock Fellow Haley Ellis, MD

jetpack-related-posts.title: Physician pioneer in palliative care establishes a research fellowship
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: In 2001, Janet L. Abrahm, MD, joined Dana-Farber Cancer Institute as a palliative care physician, becoming a pivotal force in founding and nurturing the Adult Palliative Care Program—a move that created a sea change in how Dana-Farber cares for patients with cancer and brought much-deserved attention and recognition to the field.

jetpack-related-posts.title: A Celebration for the Fellowship Program in Hematology/Oncology Chair at Dana-Farber
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Spring 2023By Colleen SullivanPhotography by Justin Knight Supporters gathered to celebrate the recently established Fellowship Program in Hematology/Oncology Chair at Dana-Farber. The endowed Chair was funded by colleagues, mentees, grateful patients, family, and friends in honor of Robert J. Mayer, MD, who served as director of the Fellowship Program for…

jetpack-related-posts.title: Schaubert Family endows visionary fellowship for lung cancer research
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: For nearly a decade, the Schaubert family has been a dedicated supporter of lung cancer research at Dana-Farber.

img.alt_text: Eileen Schaubert (center) and her daughters, Suzanne and Amy.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Dana-Farber Cancer Institute Presidential Symposium
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: In October, Dana-Farber supporters and leaders gathered for the annual Dana-Farber Cancer Institute Presidential Symposium. Attendees received firsthand updates on the State of the Institute, advances and opportunities in prevention and early detection, the impact of philanthropy on advancing research, and Dana-Farber’s world-renowned hematology/oncology fellowship program. Pictured are fellowship program…

jetpack-related-posts.title: First-ever fellowship in metastatic prostate cancer and AI research
jetpack-related-posts.author: Lori Dougherty
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Tom and Olivia McDonough's gift fuels collaboration to harness the power of AI and speed development of novel therapies against prostate cancer.

Winter 2024
By Kayla Carcone
Photography by Josh Campbell

With a generous $460,000 contribution, the Harrington Discovery Institute is propelling innovative cancer research led by Min-Ru Wu, MD, PhD, and Loren Walensky, MD, PhD, as they work to develop less toxic treatments for melanoma patients and investigate targeted therapies for other drug-resistant cancers, respectively.

jetpack-related-posts.title: AACR targets breast and uterine cancers
jetpack-related-posts.author: Lori Dougherty
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The American Association for Cancer Research recently awarded more than $1 million in grants to Dana-Farber Cancer Institute investigators.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Kevin and Kimberley Mitnick
jetpack-related-posts.author: Lori Dougherty
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Kevin and Kimberley Mitnick made a generous gift to support pancreatic cancer research by Srivatsan Raghavan, MD, PhD, before Kevin’s passing from pancreatic cancer in July 2023. This generous contribution reflects their desire to help Dana-Farber uncover new treatment options and improve outcomes for all patients facing pancreatic cancer.

img.alt_text: Kevin and Kimberley Mitnick sitting on a rock in front of the ocean

jetpack-related-posts.title: Hazel B. Harrington Trust
jetpack-related-posts.author: Lori Dougherty
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The Hazel B. Harrington Trust has made a generous gift of $124,668 to Dana-Farber Cancer Institute. This contribution, reflecting Ms. Harrington’s foresight and commitment, supports the Institute’s efforts to develop innovative cancer treatments and expand access to care. Her legacy significantly impacts patient lives and advances The Dana-Farber Campaign mission.

img.alt_text: Liquid pouring from a beaker into a petri dish

jetpack-related-posts.title: Margaret and Michael Kerr
jetpack-related-posts.author: Hannah White
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Margaret and Michael Kerr’s generous gift of $100,000 to the Kerr Family Fund for Translational Research supports the groundbreaking work of James Cleary, MD, PhD, at Dana-Farber. Their contribution will help advance innovative treatment approaches for gastrointestinal cancers, underscoring their vital role in transforming patient care.

img.alt_text: Various tubes and other lab equipment

jetpack-related-posts.title: Jeannie and Jonathan Lavine Endowed Chairs for Preventive Cancer Therapies
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: In 2020, Jeannie and Jonathan Lavine endowed three Dana-Farber Chairs in support of prevention and early detection research at the Institute, with a gift to The Dana-Farber Campaign.

img.alt_text: Catherine Wu, MD; Laurie H. Glimcher, MD; and Jonathan Lavine

jetpack-related-posts.title: Conquer Cancer® grants target several types of cancer
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Conquer Cancer®, the ASCO Foundation, has fueled groundbreaking research at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute for decades.

content.rendered:
Winter 2024
By Sofi Elbadawi

Jimmy Fund Day at Fenway presented by DraftKings raised $230,000 to support innovative cancer research and compassionate patient care at Dana-Farber. Thanks to donor support, Dana-Farber patients and their families were able to participate in this unforgettable experience and take the field at Fenway Park.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Jimmy Fund Day at Fenway
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: In September 2025, dreams became reality as more than 200 participants, including Dana-Farber patients, had the once-in-a lifetime chance to play ball at Fenway Park. Thanks to generous support from sponsors, the Boston Red Sox, fundraising teams, and donors, Jimmy Fund Day at Fenway presented by DraftKings raised more than…

img.alt_text: Three people at Fenway Park wearing Jimmy Fund jerseys

jetpack-related-posts.title: Jimmy Fund Radio-Telethon breaks records with $5.7 million raised for Dana-Farber
jetpack-related-posts.author: Hannah White
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The WEEI/NESN Jimmy Fund Radio-Telethon presented by Arbella Insurance continued to be a beacon of support for Dana-Farber Cancer Institute and the Jimmy Fund in August with a record-breaking fundraising year.

img.alt_text: Ali Kelleher cheering at Fenway Park

jetpack-related-posts.title: Milestone 20th annual WEEI/NESN Jimmy Fund Radio-Telethon raises $3.5 million
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Since 1953, the Boston Red Sox have had a deep and multifaceted impact on patients with cancer through its strong partnership with Dana-Farber and the Jimmy Fund.

img.alt_text: Dana-Farber patient and doctor on the field at Fenway Park

jetpack-related-posts.title: Expect Miracles Foundation honored with the Boston Red Sox Jimmy Fund Award
jetpack-related-posts.author: Hannah White
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Expect Miracles Foundation (EMF) received the 2025 Boston Red Sox Jimmy Fund Award—the Jimmy Fund’s highest honor—during a special on-field ceremony at Fenway Park.

img.alt_text: Group photo of Jimmy Fund Award winners and Dana-Farber staff at Fenway Park

jetpack-related-posts.title: Arbella plays an MVP role in the Jimmy Fund’s mission to strike out cancer
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: A longtime partner of Dana-Farber Cancer Institute and the Jimmy Fund, Arbella Insurance Group continued its steadfast support of Dana-Farber’s mission throughout 2023, living out the company’s motto of: “Here. For Good.”

img.alt_text: A group of people holding an over-sized check at Fenway Park

jetpack-related-posts.title: Red Sox name 2023 Jimmy Fund Captain
jetpack-related-posts.author: Colleen Sullivan
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Boston Red Sox pitcher, Garrett Whitlock, has been named Jimmy Fund Captain for the 2023 baseball season.

img.alt_text: Jimmy Fund Captain Garrett Whitlock in the Fenway dugout with pediatric patient Lily

title.rendered: The Lewin Fund to Fight Women’s Cancers

content.rendered:
Winter 2024
By Brendan Monahan

The Lewin Fund to Fight Women’s Cancers committed $300,000 to advancing clinical trials led by Joyce Liu, MD, MPH, and Elizabeth Lee, MD. This support will propel investigations in uterine papillary serous carcinoma and HER2-expressing malignancies, with the potential to elevate advances in gynecologic oncology research for all patients.

jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: With a recent $1 million gift, the Carney Family Charitable Foundation, led by Trustees Patrick and Lillian Carney, has expanded a legacy of support for breast cancer immuno-oncology research at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute that spans over 20 years.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Leukemia & Lymphoma Society grants target blood cancers
jetpack-related-posts.author: Lori Dougherty
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The Leukemia & Lymphoma Society recently awarded more than $7.3 million in grants to Dana-Farber researchers in its quest to better understand and find cures for blood cancers.

title.rendered: Dr. Gerald and Mrs. Mary McGillicuddy

content.rendered:
Winter 2024
By Colleen Sullivan
Photography by Carley Michelle Photography

Dr. Gerald and Mrs. Mary McGillicuddy made a $100,000 gift to support the work of Julia Rotow, MD, a researcher in the Lowe Center for Thoracic Oncology at Dana-Farber. With this gift, Rotow and her team will work to develop better, more effective targeted and immunotherapy options for patients with lung cancer.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Kittredges continue generous support of melanoma and immuno-oncology research
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Francis Kittredge, MD, JD, and his wife, Adele, know that supporting Dana-Farber Cancer Institute makes a difference because their philanthropy already has—and their impact continues to grow through their ongoing generosity.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Joseph C. Connolly
jetpack-related-posts.author: Hannah White
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Joseph C. Connolly made a $100,000 gift in memory of his late wife, Deborah, to support the work of Jacob Sands, MD. With this gift, Sands, along with researcher Matthew Oser, MD, PhD, will work to identify biomarkers to personalize treatment and track response to therapy in patients with small…

jetpack-related-posts.title: Free ME from Lung Cancer
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The Free ME from Lung Cancer Research Fund doubled its impact, matching a previous gift of $100,000 to support research conducted by Jia Luo, MD, in Dana-Farber’s Lowe Center for Thoracic Oncology. The investment will fuel immunotherapy research for patients with an aggressive and underfunded type of lung cancer.

img.alt_text: Free ME from Lung Cancer Research Fund logo

jetpack-related-posts.title: IBC Network Foundation
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The IBC Network Foundation made a generous $100,000 gift to advance the inflammatory breast cancer (IBC) research of Filipa Lynce, MD, FASCO. With this, Lynce will explore the ability of T-cell receptors to predict response to immunotherapy and drive progress in the treatment of IBC, which will ultimately offer hope…

jetpack-related-posts.title: Gail and Ralph Reynolds
jetpack-related-posts.author: Hannah White
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Gail and Ralph Reynolds made a gift of $100,000 to support the work of Julia Rotow, MD, and Matt Oser, MD, PhD, who are collaborating to pioneer novel treatments for lung neuroendocrine cancer. By harnessing proteins previously considered “undruggable,” they aim to improve options for patients with this complex cancer.

img.alt_text: Various tubes and other lab equipment

jetpack-related-posts.title: Tap Cancer Out
jetpack-related-posts.author: Colleen Sullivan
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Tap Cancer Out, a jiu-jitsu based nonprofit raising awareness and funds for cancer fighting organizations on behalf of the grappling community, recently made a $100,000 gift to support innovative research by Rizwan Romee, MD, into novel immunotherapeutic approaches for breast cancer at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute.

title.rendered: The Norman J. Fisher & Doris Fisher Foundation

content.rendered:
Winter 2024
By Colleen Sullivan
Photography by Bryce Vickmark

The Norman J. Fisher & Doris Fisher Foundation recently renewed their support for the Michael C. Gohl Fellowship with a generous $350,000 gift. This fellowship in thoracic oncology supports a promising early career scientist working in the lab of Pasi Jänne, MD, PhD.

jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Magda and Gus Mininberg have made a generous $200,000 contribution to strengthen the Mininberg Family Fund for Cancer Research and the Mininberg Family Fund for Lymphoma Research, guided by David C. Fisher, MD. Their generosity provides steady, strategic support to Fisher and other Dana-Farber Cancer Institute leaders pursuing better outcomes…

jetpack-related-posts.title: Mugar Foundation
jetpack-related-posts.author: Colleen Sullivan
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The Mugar Foundation made a generous commitment of $500,000 to support the previously established Mugar Family Fellowship in Lung Cancer. While advancing promising lung cancer research, the fellowship provides reliable funding for an early career scientist to pursue innovative research and develop the skills needed to lead the future of…

jetpack-related-posts.title: Lymphoma Research Foundation
jetpack-related-posts.author: Hannah White
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The Lymphoma Research Foundation awarded Dana-Farber Cancer Institute's Tianfang Ma, PhD, a generous $195,000 Postdoctoral Fellowship Grant, to bolster his research and growth as an independent investigator. Ma’s work focuses on the tumor immune microenvironment in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and may help enhance immunotherapy effectiveness and identify predictive markers…

jetpack-related-posts.title: For Kids’ Sake Foundation
jetpack-related-posts.author: Lori Dougherty
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The For Kids’ Sake Foundation has generously donated $200,000 to establish the Malia’s Legacy Loves On Fellowship at Dana-Farber, in honor of Malia Jusczyk. This two-year fellowship, managed by Robbie Majzner, MD, will support neuroblastoma research focusing on enhancing GD2-targeted therapies and overcoming treatment resistance.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Levi Garraway

jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Dana-Farber Trustee Levi Garraway, MD, PhD, has supported the Trustee Science Committee Fellowships with a generous $250,000 gift—adding a third year to the fellowship. Created to advance the research and cultivate the talent of scientists at all levels, this gift will further support fellows who are committed to finding new…

Under the guidance of principal investigator F. Winter 2024
By Cyrena Musset

The Pancreatic Cancer Action Network recently awarded $400,000 in grant funding to Institute researchers Julien Dilly, MS, and William Freed-Pastor, MD, PhD, to better understand mechanisms of response and resistance to KRAS inhibition in pancreatic cancer and improve existing pre-clinical models for this intractable disease.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Lustgarten Foundation invests $1.5 million to bring promising immunotherapy to patients with pancreatic cancer
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: When the Lustgarten Foundation was founded in 1998, fewer than 10 principal investigators across the U.S. had a primary focus on pancreatic cancer.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Lustgarten grant accelerates therapeutic discovery in pancreatic cancer
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The Lustgarten Foundation is the largest private funder of pancreatic cancer research in the world, funding preeminent pancreatic cancer researchers, driving the pursuit of bold and innovative science toward earlier detection and better treatments, and transforming pancreatic cancer into a curable disease.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Pancreatic Cancer Action Network
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: With their latest commitment of $300,000, the Pancreatic Cancer Action Network is supporting the work of Dana-Farber’s Andrew Aguirre, MD, PhD, who aims to identify the mechanisms of response or resistance to a combination treatment for pancreatic cancer.

jetpack-related-posts.title: The Hale Family receives the Sidney Farber Medical Research Award
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: In November 2023, Dana-Farber Trustee Judy Hale, Dana-Farber Trustee Karen Hale, Rob Hale, Elizabeth Hale Kendall, and Richard Kendall were awarded the Sidney Farber Medical Research Award in recognition of the Hale Family’s outstanding contributions and service to the Institute for many decades.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Kevin and Kimberley Mitnick
jetpack-related-posts.author: Lori Dougherty
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Kevin and Kimberley Mitnick made a generous gift to support pancreatic cancer research by Srivatsan Raghavan, MD, PhD, before Kevin’s passing from pancreatic cancer in July 2023. This generous contribution reflects their desire to help Dana-Farber uncover new treatment options and improve outcomes for all patients facing pancreatic cancer.

img.alt_text: Kevin and Kimberley Mitnick sitting on a rock in front of the ocean

jetpack-related-posts.title: The Dana-Farber Campaign: Stopping cancer before it starts
jetpack-related-posts.author: Lori Dougherty
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The Dana-Farber Campaign dramatically advanced the prevention, early detection, and interception of cancers on a wide variety of fronts.

img.alt_text: Researchers at work in the Centers for Early Detection and Interception.

content.rendered:
Winter 2024
By Lucy McDonald

George Phillips, together with his daughters, Kimberly and Jill, established the Juliana M. Phillips Fund Accelerating Cancer Research in honor of his late wife, Juliana (pictured), with a $150,000 gift. The fund will offer essential financial support for research into pancreatic, esophageal, gastric, and other gastrointestinal cancers, under the leadership of Peter Enzinger, MD.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Carla L. DeSantis
jetpack-related-posts.author: Lori Dougherty
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Carla L. DeSantis established the Robert A. DeSantis Fund for Cancer Research with a gift of $150,000 in memory of her father. With this investment, Brian Wolpin, MD, and his team in the Gastrointestinal Cancer Center are well-positioned to design new clinical trials with the goal of developing more effective…

img.alt_text: Carla DeSantis in front of a tree

jetpack-related-posts.title: Arthur David Levin
jetpack-related-posts.author: Lori Dougherty
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: With a gift of $100,000, Arthur David Levin established the Andrew John Torino Fund for Esophageal Cancer in honor of a dear friend’s husband, Andrew. This fund will advance the development of a new test to detect circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) in the blood, with the goal of determining the…

jetpack-related-posts.title: The DeGregorio Family Foundation continues to advance gastroesophageal cancer treatment
jetpack-related-posts.author: Lori Dougherty
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Gastric and esophageal cancers often resist chemotherapy and metastasize easily. The DeGregorio Family Foundation aims to address this challenge with more than $500,000 in grant funding to Dana-Farber Cancer Institute to develop new treatments.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Julie Wallace Bennett
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: With a $250,000 gift, Julie Wallace Bennett established the Peter Warren Fund for Pancreatic Research, in honor of her partner, Peter. Brian Wolpin, MD, MPH, the Robert T. and Judith B. Hale Chair in Pancreatic Cancer at Dana-Farber will lead this research.

img.alt_text: A photo of a couple in front of a body water

jetpack-related-posts.title: Joe Connolly
jetpack-related-posts.author: Colleen Sullivan
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Joe Connolly established the Deborah Connolly Small Cell Lung Cancer Research Fund at Dana-Farber in honor of his late wife, with a gift of $100,000. The fund will support research such as studies of the molecular mutations driving small cell lung cancer, with the goal of developing targeted therapies.

jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Joe Connolly gave $100,000 to fund critical small cell lung cancer research at Dana-Farber. Established in honor of Connolly’s late wife, the Deborah A. content.rendered:
Winter 2024
By Lori Dougherty

A $100,000 gift has been made to establish The Ellen C. Lewin Music Therapy Fund. This fund will support a comprehensive music therapy program in the Leonard P. Zakim Center for Integrative Therapies and Healthy Living, aimed at reducing anxiety and stress in patients and staff. The Redstone Family, one of the Institute’s founding families, made this generous pledge, joined by friends and family of Ellen (pictured) to honor her love of music.

jetpack-related-posts.title: The Lewin Fund to Fight Women’s Cancers
jetpack-related-posts.author: Lori Dougherty
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The Lewin Fund to Fight Women’s Cancers committed $300,000 to advancing clinical trials led by Joyce Liu, MD, MPH, and Elizabeth Lee, MD. This support will propel investigations in uterine papillary serous carcinoma and HER2-expressing malignancies, with the potential to elevate advances in gynecologic oncology research for all patients.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Clifford Family
jetpack-related-posts.author: Colleen Sullivan
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The Clifford Family established the Woolley-Clifford Foundation Fund with a $100,000 gift, supporting the research of David Kozono, MD, PhD, as he works to investigate blood and tissue-based biomarkers in lung cancer patients that can help predict lung inflammation and anti-tumor response following radiation therapy.

img.alt_text: Liquid pouring from a beaker into a petri dish

jetpack-related-posts.title: Alka Ohri Foundation enhances holistic breast cancer care
jetpack-related-posts.author: Lori Dougherty
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: A recent grant will help launch a personalized program designed to preserve patients’ strength, endurance, and mobility throughout the breast cancer continuum.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Zakim Center turns 25: Donor generosity continues to fuel integrative therapies
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: When the late Leonard “Lenny” Zakim was being treated for multiple myeloma in the 1990s, he found that complementary therapies such as acupuncture, massage, and Tai Chi eased the side effects of chemotherapy and radiation.

img.alt_text: Five members of the Zakim family

jetpack-related-posts.title: Micki and Steven Hirsch
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Clinical trials are considered essential for groundbreaking research. To help advance Dana-Farber Cancer Institute’s clinical trials, Micki and Steven Hirsch made a gift of $100,000 to the Hirsch Family Fund for the Office of Clinical Research. Jeffrey Meyerhardt, MD, MPH, FASCO, leads the program which has benefited from the generous…

jetpack-related-posts.title: Dr. James and Mrs. Deborah Fanale
jetpack-related-posts.author: Lori Dougherty
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Dr. James and Mrs. Deborah Fanale made a gift of $100,000 to establish a fund supporting patient caregivers in the Department of Supportive Oncology. James, a stage IV lung cancer patient, is donating proceeds from his book, “ONWARD: A Teaching, And A Love Story - For Physicians, And Everyone” to…

title.rendered: The Terri Brodeur Breast Cancer Foundation

content.rendered:
Winter 2024
By Brendan Monahan

The Terri Brodeur Breast Cancer Foundation gave $125,000 in support of research led by Paolo Tarantino, MD, which seeks to improve the precision of antibody-drug conjugates. This funding will aid Tarantino in unlocking new insights into metastatic breast cancer, with the intention of identifying additional treatments for patients.

Kuziel’s work aims to develop innovative combination therapies, with the goal of transforming treatment options and improving outcomes…

One explores circulating tumor DNA at critical timepoints in early stage hormone receptor-positive breast cancer, and the second assesses how chemotherapy effects the tumor-immune microenvironment and estrogen receptor activity in young…

jetpack-related-posts.title: METAvivor advances metastatic breast cancer research

content.rendered:
Winter 2024

Dear Friends,

Dana-Farber is a place where extraordinary things happen. Over the last seven years of The Dana-Farber Campaign, we have all seen it in action. Thanks to the tenacity and generosity of our entire community, we are defying cancer.

Behind every breakthrough is a story. In this issue, we celebrate the story of one of our longest and most exceptional partnerships: the Pan-Mass Challenge (PMC). This year the PMC surpassed an astounding cumulative total of $1 billion raised since 1980—an extraordinary achievement 45 years in the making, and all thanks to the incredible riders, volunteers, and philanthropists who have dedicated so much to our patients.

Throughout the Institute’s history, we have seen the power of partnerships—donors and organizations who believe in Dana-Farber and have invested in our mission. Drugs like Gleevec, a potent targeted therapy, and Keytruda, one of the first FDA-approved PD-1 inhibitors, are now household names and used to treat many types of cancer. These life-changing breakthroughs—plus more than half of the cancer drugs approved by the FDA in the past five years—would not have been possible without the powerhouse combination of Dana-Farber’s scientists and philanthropy.

Through The Dana-Farber Campaign, hundreds of thousands of people have enabled us to develop lifesaving treatments for the patients who need them. Our work continues, and I am grateful to have all of you working alongside us to defy cancer. In the next issue of Impact, we will share our collective thanks for this remarkable community, including Dr. Glimcher, the Campaign Cabinet, our Trustees, and our faculty, clinical partners, and staff, all of whom have contributed to this historic effort’s success.

Wishing you a warm and happy holiday season,

Melany N. Duval
Senior Vice President and Chief Philanthropy Officer

jetpack-related-posts.title: A Message from Melany Duval
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Over the past seven years, The Dana-Farber Campaign has enabled incredible progress at the Institute, the effects of which ripple out to help patients around the world.

jetpack-related-posts.title: A Message from Melany Duval
jetpack-related-posts.author: Dana-Farber Impact
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: When I first stepped into my role at Dana-Farber in 2019, I was immediately struck by the endless compassion and dedication of the people around me.

jetpack-related-posts.title: A Message from Melany Duval
jetpack-related-posts.author: Colleen Sullivan
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: One of the things that makes Dana-Farber such a special place is our emphasis on teamwork.

jetpack-related-posts.title: A Message from Melany Duval
jetpack-related-posts.author: Hannah White
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Dear friends, Every day our philanthropic community supports a relentless commitment to possibilities in cancer care at Dana-Farber—and that gives me hope.

jetpack-related-posts.title: A Message from Melany Duval
jetpack-related-posts.author: Hannah White
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: As I reflect on this past year, I am filled with immense gratitude for the generosity and unwavering commitment of our Dana-Farber community. Your steadfast support has been a driving force behind so many of our achievements, and it is because of you that we have been able to navigate…
